authored_easy.basis: Same two-intermediate, two-independent-variable chain rule; linear outer function and two affine maps remove nonlinear differentiation and expansion. Both nonzero chain contributions remain.

bounded_policy.whole_bank_collision_action: Reject entire instance; never drop or pool distractors.
bounded_policy.identity_policy: Retain content UUIDs across seed and choice order changes. Deduplicate fresh content against the complete existing KP and canonical example using a parsed symbolic derivative plus held coordinate; canceled shifts do not add inventory.

exceptions.bound: All 12 complete source banks replay exactly at original parameters. Historical incorrect-option intent is unresolved; translated observed banks are evidence-only and excluded from new learning content. Normal generation uses explicitly authored complete operation banks.
Easy is an explicitly authored same-method affine reduction, with no captured easy source rating. Its function/map roles and worked stages are retained and independently validated.

Independent integer translations are limited to -2..2. Canceled input changes, alternate identities and option shuffles never count as fresh tasks. If this bounded candidate search cannot supply five distinct available questions in a supported band, retain its numeric shortage and report finite-limit; no unlimited-capacity claim.
